issue.body: "Quote expressions" are expressions that start with an identifier followed by a comma, allowing arbitrary syntax to follow. These kinds of expressions would throw a an error in the template type checker, which would make them hard to track down. As quote expressions are not generally used at all, the error would typically occur for URLs that would inadvertently occur in a binding: ```html ``` This commit lets such bindings be inferred as the `any` type. Fixes #36568 Resolves FW-2051
